pages.heading: Komodo Dragon
pages.body: Sparse jungles. Hostile, poisonous, and dangerous to weakened members of its own species. Taming consumes multiple full stacks of rotten flesh. A tame dragon

pages.heading: Komodo Dragon (cont.)
pages.body: can be saddled and commanded. Collected spit supports Poison Resistance brewing and slimeball crafting. Separate vulnerable young from adults.
